title: Rectangular steel flexural control
construction: Create a closed World-YZ rectangle with Y limits -0.15 and 0.15 m and Z limits -0.6 and 0 m.
Create a World-YZ circle centered at (0,0,-0.56) with radius 0.0252313252202016 m.
Connect all ten explicit inputs to Material Properties; do not use global material settings.
Connect MP, Mu=[-100], rectangle Ag, circle As, and m=100 to Flexural Analysis.
Set Select Code=0, recompute, and export code-0 observations.
Set Select Code=1, recompute, and export code-1 observations.
Capture Mn, Acomp area, and Acomp bounding-box depth for each code.

gates.cardinality: Each code case produces one row per metric.
